headline: Bank Lending Grows 13.65% Through August 2026, NPL Still Healthy Despite Starting to Rise
summary: Bank lending in Indonesia grew 13.65% through August 2026. Asset quality remained sound, although non-performing loans rose in certain segments.
why: Bank loan growth is a key indicator of credit demand and economic activity. Rising non-performing loans signal stress in specific borrower groups that lenders monitor.
